name: spreadsheet-api
comment: Intentionally declares NO dependencies. This package lives inside scriptorium/ and shares its node_modules — server.js imports yjs/y-websocket/y-utility transitively through ../src code. Declaring them here (and running `npm install` in this dir) creates a SECOND copy of yjs, which breaks `instanceof Y.Array` checks in schema.js ("Yjs was already imported" warning) and silently makes cell reads return null. Do not add a dependencies block; do not create spreadsheet-api/node_modules.
